title: Billie's record dates after the split, and his cocaine paranoia
summary: He played on all her dates despite delays; his cocaine use made him violent.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: I mean, she'd take time out between records and go in the ladies room, the powder room to try to get herself together. And she'd be in there an hour, an hour and a half. And the session would eventually run into a double session. We didn't mind that, it was money for us but Norman Granz and different

people was pulling their hair. It was running money out of their pockets. So I found out what was happening to her and I was sniffing cocaine at the time, you know. I had graduated from grass to cocaine. Well cocaine don't let you get greasy and what not, it makes you more concerned with your hygiene and your person, you know, how you look. But you get very paranoid. You can't stand a lot of noise.

And people would walk up to me and slap me on the shoulder. Hello John! And when they'd do that, I'd turn around and go upside their head. And I hit a dude, about six-two or six-three and I'd say, oh my God what have I done. Small as I was. So I'd have to take him with the element of surprise. First thing I'd do is stomp on his instep. He'd say 'ow' and start to jumping around on one foot. He'd put it down, I'd get ready and kick his shins. He'd grab them. He grab his shins now and I'd go to his testicles with my foot and he'd grab them and bend over and when he'd bend over, I'd go under his chin with my knee.

And then he'd fall flat ass back. And I'd get up in his face with the heel of foot in his mouth., And play orthodontist, take his teeth out, try to kick his nose off his face. Stick both feet in his eyes (laughter). People would say, 'John Simmons gone crazy. See he's just whipping a everybody.'
